paragraphs: Mastercard Inc. (stylized as MasterCard from 1979 to 2016 and as mastercard since 2016) is an American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York. It provides payment transaction processing and other related-payment services, including travel-related payments and bookings. Its principal business globally is to process payments between the banks of merchants and the card-issuing banks or credit unions of purchasers who use its branded debit, credit and prepaid cards to make purchases. Mastercard has been publicly traded since 2006.

Mastercard (originally Interbank, then Master Charge) was created by an alliance of several banks and regional bankcard associations in response to the BankAmericard issued by Bank of America, which later became Visa and remains its biggest competitor. Both companies have faced numerous antitrust lawsuits. Prior to its initial public offering, Mastercard Worldwide was a cooperative owned by the more than 25,000 financial institutions that issue its branded cards.

people.name: Merit E. Janow

people.quote: We have an independent Board Chairperson, Merit E. Janow.

people.name: Candido Bracher
people.title: Director; Former CEO, Ita Unibanco Group
people.bio: Served as Chief Executive Officer of Ita Unibanco Group from 2017 to 2021, following roles as Senior Vice President, Wholesale Banking and Vice President.
people.quote: Mr. Bracher brings to the Board extensive payments experience and consumer insight

people.name: Richard K. Davis
people.title: Director; Former Executive Chairman and CEO, U.S. Bancorp
people.bio: Served as U.S. Bancorp's Chief Executive Officer from 2006 to 2017 and Executive Chairman from 2017 to 2018. He subsequently served as CEO of Make-A-Wish America and has chaired Mayo Clinic's Board of Trustees since 2025.
people.quote: Mr. Davis brings to the Board extensive payments experience and consumer insight

people.name: Julius Genachowski
people.title: Director; Former Chairman, U.S. Federal Communications Commission
people.bio: Chaired the U.S. Federal Communications Commission from 2009 to 2013. He was a Partner and Managing Director at The Carlyle Group from 2014 to 2023 and has served as Senior Advisor since 2024.
people.quote: In January 2026, Julius Genachowski rotated from the Human Resources and Compensation Committee to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee.

people.name: Michael Miebach
people.title: Chief Executive Officer and President; Director
people.bio: Has served as Mastercard's Chief Executive Officer and President since January 2021, after serving as President, Chief Product Officer, and President, Middle East and Africa. Previously held executive roles at Barclays and Citigroup.
people.quote: Michael Miebach, our President and CEO, focuses on managing the company's operations and strategy

people.name: Youngme Moon
people.title: Director; Donald K. David Professor of Business Administration, Harvard Business School
people.bio: Has been Donald K. David Professor of Business Administration at Harvard Business School since 2008. Previously served as Senior Associate Dean for Strategy and Innovation and the MBA Program from 2010 to 2014.
people.quote: Professor Moon brings to the Board a deep understanding of strategy and innovation

people.name: Harit Talwar

people.quote: Mr. Talwar brings to the Board extensive senior-level global payments experience and consumer insight

people.name: Lance Uggla

people.quote: Mr. Uggla brings to the Board a global perspective as well as deep insight across data, technology and innovation
